subject: Adaptive batching causing disconnects in Lumina POC — request to expose runtime batch config
messages:
From: logan_wright@redwood.ai
To: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai, dev_patel@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-09-03T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: Repro notes — Lumina POC streaming disconnects (adaptive batching enabled)

Team,

Observed a reproducible disconnect during Lumina's POC demo yesterday when they enable adaptive batching + prefix/KV caching. Short summary: once payloads cross ~120KB and the client has a burst pattern (8 rapid calls / 3s) the SDK session goes into reconnect loops and we see 503s from the runtime.

Repro steps (local / field):
1) Start the SDK session with adaptive batching ON (default) and prefix caching enabled.
2) Send 8 requests ~250ms apart each, average payload ~18–25KB.
3) After ~5 minutes of sustained bursts, client logs: multiple 503 from /v1/generate + SDK reconnect attempts.

Attached: error_trace.txt (server-side 503s / stack traces) and screencap.png (console showing reconnect).

We reproduced this twice on the customer's staging region (us-west). Customer is demoing to their procurement committee next Wednesday and asked for a stable experience. Short-term ask: can platform suggest a conservative runtime flag we can set on their Dedicated pool to stop the reconnects? Even a per-client override would be ideal.

I'm copying Vivek and Marissa to coordinate the customer-facing notes and next steps.

Thanks,
Logan Wright
Sales Engineer
Redwood Inference
From: dev_patel@redwood.ai
To: logan_wright@redwood.ai, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-09-04T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Repro notes — Lumina POC streaming disconnects (adaptive batching enabled)

Thanks for the detailed repro, Logan — very helpful. A few quick notes and a short-term workaround:

What I'm seeing (hypothesis): when adaptive batching tries to aggregate bursts while KV/prefix cache is also active, we may hit a timing window where cache entries are evicted (or cache misses spike) and the runtime backpressure path returns 503 rather than cleanly queueing. That coincides with the reconnect behavior in the SDK.

Immediate workaround to try on the customer's Dedicated pool:
- Set REDWOOD_BATCH_WINDOW_MS=5 (default is 20) to reduce the batching aggregation window.
- Disable prefix prefetch for the specific app (toggle PREFETCH_KV=false) if feasible.

If you want me to, I can apply these to their staging pool for the next 24h so you can re-run the demo.

What I need from you to triage fully:
- Full runtime telemetry (I see partial traces in error_trace.txt, need the corresponding spans). If you can upload the expanded trace link that would help.
- Heap and GC spikes from the serving nodes during the incident window.

Note: longer term, exposing a server-side per-client batch-window override (API header or model config) sounds reasonable. I can start a brief design doc and link it to INF-7281. For now, try the batch window tweak and let me know results.

-- Dev Patel
Platform / Runtime Engineer
Redwood Inference
From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: dev_patel@redwood.ai, logan_wright@redwood.ai, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-09-05T14:28:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Repro notes — Lumina POC streaming disconnects (adaptive batching enabled)

Quick product/pm ask and customer context from my side:

Customer impact: Lumina's use-case is high-throughput chart summarization with many short bursts from clinical clients. They plan to put Redwood behind an internal integration gateway and need a per-tenant control (they can't afford global behavior changes).

Product ask (field request): can we expose a per-client override for the adaptive batching window and an explicit "deprioritize batching" header? Example API proposal: X-REDWOOD-BATCH-HINT: "force-min-window=5" or "no-adaptive-batching".

Why this matters:
- Fast path: gives sales/SEs a supported knob to stabilize demos and early production without full runtime code changes.
- Low risk: implementing as a config-layer check is straightforward and can be guarded behind a feature flag / enterprise-only toggle.

Timeline ask: Lumina's procurement demo is next Wed (2026-09-15). Can Platform/PM provide a short-term supported workaround + eta for a guarded server-side header in the next 2 weeks? I've attached the mutual_action_plan.docx for the customer meeting pack — they expect a documented mitigation.

If product needs a formal RFC, I can own that with SE input.

Marissa Cole
Lead Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
To: dev_patel@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, logan_wright@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-09-07T16:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Repro notes — Lumina POC streaming disconnects (adaptive batching enabled)

Appreciate the quick responses. Consolidating action items so we have a single source of truth: 

1) Short-term (apply in staging today) — Dev: please apply REDWOOD_BATCH_WINDOW_MS=5 and PREFETCH_KV=false to Lumina's staging Dedicated pool and confirm whether reconnects stop. Owner: dev_patel (due: 2026-09-08 EOD).
2) Diagnostic: Dev to attach full runtime spans and GC/heap metrics to INF-7281 so SRE/Product can reproduce. Owner: dev_patel (due: 2026-09-09).
3) Field product ask: Marissa -- please convert the header API proposal into a one-page RFC (example header names, guardrails, rollout plan). Product/Runtime should review. Owner: marissa_cole (due: 2026-09-09).
4) JIRA: Dev/Platform to create INF-7281 with tags [adaptive-batching, per-client-config, priority-P1] and link back to HubSpot deal HD-48920. Owner: dev_patel (please create and paste link here).
5) Customer comms: Logan/Vivek -- I'll draft the short note to Lumina summarizing the workaround and next steps after Dev confirms staging behavior. Target send: 2026-09-10.

Marissa: if Product signs off on the header RFC quickly, can Platform provide a guarded implementation (feature-flagged) candidate for canary in Dedicated by 2026-09-14? That would give us one day buffer before their demo. If not, we'll lean on the staging config workaround and document it for procurement.

I'll put this thread into the Lumina POC folder and link the HubSpot and JIRA items once INF-7281 exists. Please reply with owner confirmations and any blockers.

Thanks — Vivek
